Docket 1.3.158

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A page with a long block of CSS no longer stalls the audit.* Reading the fonts a page uses rescanned the end of a
  long style block once for every character in it. A page carrying 26 KB of CSS comments held the audit for about nine
  seconds, long enough for the app to lose touch with the engine while it ran. The same page now takes a few
  milliseconds.
- *More of the app is tested before every release.* The browser tests of every screen, the accessibility checks of the
  app itself and the Chrome add-on's tests now run on every build, and a release is refused if any of them fails or
  skips.

99 checks across 13 areas.
